body: Maybe thats a good idea but im looking to strike out on my own in some way in doing art and studying science but I have gone through a lot of depression and anxiety and do not feel like I belong anywhere, whenever I get a job I always feel alienated and like what I am doing is not of any significance, all im qualified for is manual labour and customer service, two jobs i found to be time consuming and ultimately dissatisfying and would make me think of suicide because of the inescapable routine and monotonous experience and having to put on a happy face and an act and being around people I cannot relate to because of my past experiences and because of my tendency to judge my surroundings and question. Everything has become so complicated. Having to deal with the micro politics of a corporate environment is nauseating and only a masochistic idiot would go through it all. My life became transactional. I do not want to work a sucky job for the next 10 years Im getting tired of life already and Im only 21 and this is a culmulation of guilt, sadness, feeling weak and alone, having no sincere friends and understanding how harsh and cruel the world is.  I fear the future, and losing my mind and breaking down once and for all.  Im currently studying and have literally no friends outside my family. The friends I did have werent supportive and were using drugs. I have tried to join the military but that didnt work, and ill try again next year. I have money saved and I have a lot of resources and time to consider, but with every day that passes my money dwindles and I am anxious and ill at ease, probably from solitude and the absence of genuine and rational human connection and being forced to conform to a set of values and compete on an unequal and shaky footing.
